verdict.rationale: Teller has no explicit refresh endpoint. However, its balances API is documented as returning live, real-time balances, which in effect gives a developer now-fresh balance data on demand from its own API. Beyond that 'live' claim, the refresh semantics are not documented, and nothing establishes freshness for transactions or other data. Missing for 10: an explicit refresh-trigger endpoint, documented refresh semantics (timing, rate limits, async vs sync behavior), on-demand freshness for transactions and other data, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can trigger an on-demand refresh of a connected account's data through the API when my use case needs now-fresh data, with the refresh semantics documented

citations.quote: The account balances API provides your application with live, real-time account balances.
Guaranteed live account balances. Used for underwriting or ensuring sufficient funds are available before submitting an ACH debit.
